question: What happens to lower principles when higher principles function as the measure?
premises: Higher and higher principles can function as the measure.
When that status is determined, lower principles are viewed in relation to them.
The lower and lower principles then take on the status of objects.
inference: When higher principles serve as the measuring subject, the lower principles become the measured objects.
plain_english: When the group of higher and higher principles is established as the measure, the portion of lower and lower principles takes on the status of object.
